fix(athena): route by each engine's rules when the combined tokenizer fails [CLAUDE] (#8629)

Routing tokenizes with the union of Hive and Trino rules, which rejects literals
that are valid in a single engine: '\' or ESCAPE '\' in Trino and "a\"b" in Hive.
A failure there only means the union can't route the statement, so each engine's
own tokenizer is tried and used if its tokens route to that engine. Statements
the union tokenizes are unaffected.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
test_patch:
